description: This file defines the TrendLine class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically in the chart namespace. It encapsulates properties and methods for configuring trend lines in charts, including types, order, period, display options, and associated parameters.

classes.name: TrendLine
classes.description: Represents a trend line configuration in a chart, supporting different types of trend lines, with properties such as order, period, and display options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new TrendLine object with optional configuration parameters.

methods.name: getTrendLineType
methods.description: Returns the type of trend line (e.g., linear, exponential).

methods.name: setTrendLineType
methods.description: Sets the type of trend line.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Returns the order of the trend line polynomial.

methods.name: setOrder
methods.description: Sets the order of the trend line polynomial.

methods.name: getPeriod
methods.description: Returns the period for moving average trend lines.

methods.name: setPeriod
methods.description: Sets the period for moving average trend lines.

methods.name: getDispRSqr
methods.description: Returns whether the R-squared value is displayed.

methods.name: setDispRSqr
methods.description: Sets display of the R-squared value.

methods.name: getDispEq
methods.description: Returns whether the equation is displayed.

methods.name: setDispEq
methods.description: Sets display of the trend line equation.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the trend line.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the trend line.

methods.name: getBackward
methods.description: Returns the backward extension in units.

methods.name: setBackward
methods.description: Sets the backward extension parameter.

methods.name: getForward
methods.description: Returns the forward extension in units.

methods.name: setForward
methods.description: Sets the forward extension parameter.

methods.name: getIntercept
methods.description: Returns the intercept value.

methods.name: setIntercept
methods.description: Sets the intercept value.

methods.name: setTrendLineProperties
methods.description: Bulk method to set multiple trend line properties at once.
